benchmark.adv_table_note: per-session ADV from each dataset's instruments.json adv_by_session ('session')
benchmark.child_exec: none (the v1.17 child; capped / peg variants are not in this family)

latency_assumption.name: L0: exchange timestamps, no measured order-entry latency
latency_assumption.iex_clock: exchange (IEX send timestamps aligned to Nasdaq exchange timestamps)
latency_assumption.internal_legs: ExecConfig.latency defaults (decision / risk / wire, 200 microseconds total) for both venues
latency_assumption.not_measured: The REL-04 IEX capture-timestamp re-ingest has NOT run; no feed or order-entry latency is measured. A re-run with measured latency is a SEPARATE declaration and prereg.

sensitivity_note: reported beside the headline; never part of the decision; completion-cost sensitivity is read from completion_charge_bps (co-primary) and residual_qty, no extra run

statistics.contrast: policy - pin_nasdaq on the same parents (session, symbol, window, algo, size), pooled over all 16 cells, per symbol
statistics.estimator: difference of quantity-weighted pooled ratios, CR1 cluster-linearised SE, one cluster per session, Student-t at G-1 df (iap.research.execution_metrics.ratio_diff_stats)
statistics.family: 3 policies (pin_iex, sor, sor_sweep) x 2 symbols (AAPL, MSFT)

decision_rule.better: ci_family of d(trading cost per filled share) entirely < 0 AND ci_family of d(fill rate) not entirely < 0 AND ci_family of d(completion charge) not entirely > 0
decision_rule.worse: ci_family of d(trading cost per filled share) entirely > 0 OR ci_family of d(fill rate) entirely < 0
decision_rule.no_evidence: anything else; reported with the sign and size
decision_rule.underpowered: added to no_evidence when mde_t_family of the primary exceeds economic_threshold_bps (or of fill rate exceeds fill_rate_threshold)
decision_rule.policy_claim: a policy is better than pin_nasdaq only if it is 'better' on BOTH symbols

small_g: G = 3 evaluation sessions (2 regimes, Dec 2025 and May 2026): the interval has 2 df, t(0.975, 2) = 4.30 and t(1 - 0.025/6, 2) = 10.89. The inference rests on 3 clusters; the run reports size, not power; 'underpowered' is the expected verdict for effects near 1 bps and is stated here before the run.

reproducibility.serialisation: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, indent=2) + LF, the benchmark's own writer; rows in the benchmark's stable order
reproducibility.dependencies: the CI lock file (.venv-ci) at the bound commit
reproducibility.reproduced: byte-identical JSON where achievable; otherwise every bps within 0.01, every fraction within 0.0001 and every count exact, with each difference listed
